title: Butterflies Taste With Their Feet
description: A butterfly can tell if a leaf is right for its eggs just by standing on it.

scenes.text: Butterflies can taste with their feet.
scenes.subject: butterfly
scenes.say: [excited] Butterflies can taste... with their FEET.

scenes.text: They have special taste sensors on their legs. The moment they land on something, they can tell what it is made of.
scenes.subject: butterfly
scenes.say: They have special taste sensors on their legs. The moment they land on something, they can tell what it is made of.

scenes.text: This matters most for mothers. A female butterfly drums her feet on a leaf to check if it is the right plant for her caterpillars to eat.
scenes.subject: butterfly
scenes.say: [softly] This matters most for mothers. A female butterfly drums her feet on a leaf to check if it is the right plant for her caterpillars to eat.

scenes.text: If the taste is wrong, she flies off and keeps searching. Her babies depend on that tiny foot test.
scenes.subject: butterfly
scenes.say: [sighs] If the taste is wrong, she flies off and keeps searching. Her babies depend on that tiny foot test.

scenes.text: Imagine tasting your dinner by stepping on it. Follow for more weird facts.
